title: ADR index 'Status hygiene' still has the implementing PR flip the ADR status line in the same PR, against ruling B
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① documentation defect with a named producer (a generated rule that reads against `AGENTS.md` and the pm-dispatch references on `main`), raised as nit N1 by the contract review of PR #32531 (6813722700). ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## The text

`scripts/adr-index.mjs` `CONVENTIONS` (L379 on `main` 216674301), rendered into `docs/adr/README.md` L9: "**Status hygiene.** A PR that lands an ADR's implementation flips that ADR's `**Status**:` line to `Accepted — implemented` with one line of evidence (key file + test), in the same PR."

## Why it reads wrong

Ruling record 6797014134 (B): an implementation card's file surface excludes `docs/adr/**`; the ADR bookkeeping line is filed by the landing seat after the code merges, as its own `domain:skills` card citing the merge commit. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` L110-111 and `triage-duties.md` L71 say this since PR #32486; PR #32531 brings `AGENTS.md`'s `packages/services/**` row to the same rule. The README line is the one remaining text telling the implementing PR to edit `docs/adr/**` in the same PR. The fix is in the generator; the README is regenerated from it.

## Reach

Every dev implementing an ADR who reads the ADR index conventions.

## Duplicate check

Searched open issues for "Status hygiene" and "flips that ADR": none.
